name: Second Memory
source:
This is a romance adventure game presented in an anthology format. The stories tackle the theme that "love and romance are invisible and unpredictable things, but sometimes they become important issues" .

[Edited from TAKERU Press 1995-8/9]
translation:
这是一款以选集形式呈现的浪漫冒险游戏。这些故事的主题是“爱情和浪漫是看不见的、不可预测的事物，但有时它们会成为重要的问题”。

[编辑自TAKERU Press 1995-8/9]
